non_defects.text: **Payments KR P2.1** (chargeback 0.9% → 0.45%): an ambitious but legitimate 2x cut — far below AP-07's >5x bar, with the mechanism (P2.2 step-up coverage) stated on the same page.

**Growth KR G1.3** ("Launch self-serve plan upgrades by Aug 15 and drive 300 upgrades through the new flow this quarter"): carries a countable adoption outcome (300 upgrades), so neither AP-01 nor AP-14 applies despite "Launch... by". (Its date is load-bearing evidence for A3, which *is* on the key.)

**Data KR D2.1** ("Ship personalized onboarding checklists and cut new-signup support tickets in the first 7 days from 38 per 100 signups to 20"): a delivery verb opens the KR, but its measure is a support-ticket rate new signups move by having a better first week — shipping the checklists to everyone does not satisfy it — and it states a baseline→target pair with an explicit denominator. Not AP-01.

**Payments KR P1.1 vs Growth KR G2.1**: "checkout success rate" (91.2% → 95%, card transactions) and "checkout conversion" (58% → 68%, self-serve signups) are different metrics with different names and populations — not AL-08 and not AL-09.
**AP-08 · Committed vs Aspirational Not Labeled does not fire**: every team page states a commitment convention and Growth marks G2.3 aspirational.
**Company C3 vs Payments KR P2.1**: "under 0.5%" and "to 0.45%" are consistent targets on the same metric — not AL-02 and not AL-09.

**Platform Objective PL1** ("Keep the lights on, cheaper"): the objective names a change — *cheaper* — and KR PL1.2 realizes it with a baseline→target pair ("Reduce cloud spend per 1,000 transactions from $4.10 to $3.20"). Operational-sounding wording wrapped around a named, measured change is not AP-10; the anti-pattern is for an objective that commits the team to no change at all.

**Data KR D1.1** ("Cut cross-source metric discrepancies flagged by the weekly exec-dashboard reconciliation check from 14 to 0, by serving all product events from unified event schema v2"): the schema-v2 migration is named as the mechanism, not as the measure — the KR is scored on a discrepancy count the dashboard's consumers see. Not AP-01.

render.intro: Grades **single-team mode** against this same fixture — no separate fixture needed.
render.run: review the **Platform team** alone, in single-team mode. Input scope: the "Platform team — Q3 2026" section plus the "Appendix — Q2 2026 business review (extracts)" section. The company-priorities section is **not** provided, so the report must state that company-level strategy tracing was out of scope. Content from other teams' sections is outside the slice's input scope.
must: surface **G4 (AP-02 · Binary KR with No Gradient), G5 (AP-06 · Sandbagged Target), and G7 (AP-04 · KR Without Baseline)**, each cited by canonical ID with verbatim quotes and source refs — G5 quoting **both** the KR and the appendix's trailing actual (the cross-source rule applies unchanged in single-team mode);

report **zero AL-XX findings** — Platform's notes tempt a contention/dependency story, but the counterparty is out of scope; cross-team mentions belong under outbound dependency notes, unverified, with no severity;

score **O4 as N/A** per the rubric's no-strategy-source rule (no strategy source exists in the slice's input scope), with the rubric's gap note recorded in the score section — not a findings-section entry, and not counted against the budget below;
contain **zero fabricated quotes** — every quoted span must exist character-for-character in this file;
raise **no more than 1 finding beyond the three in item 1**, with any finding grounded in content outside the slice's input scope counting against that budget.

triage.decision: Fixed by change fix-fixture1-precision-extras (2026-09-10): the reports were right and non-defect N3 was wrong. "Ship personalized onboarding checklists to 100% of new signups" measures the rollout, which the team completes by shipping, so N3's "adoption measure" rationale asserted a property its text did not have. D2.1 now states a support-ticket rate new signups move, keeping "Ship" as its opening verb so the row stays a near-miss, and N3's rationale is rewritten against the new text. AP-01 also gained a rescue clause so the boundary is decidable rather than a matter of taste.

triage.decision: Fixed by change fix-fixture1-precision-extras (2026-09-10): a false positive. AP-10's detect line said the objective "describes the team's standing job with no delta" without saying where to look for the delta, so BAU-sounding wording fired the anti-pattern on an objective that names a real change. The rule now tests the objective statement: it fires only when the objective asserts continuation and names no change, and not when it names a change at least one KR realizes with a baseline→target pair. PL1 names "cheaper" and KR PL1.2 realizes it. Non-defect N7 records the verdict. The test is deliberately not "do the KRs carry deltas": fixture 2's planted AP-10 (Core Systems Objective CS1) has KRs with real deltas and must keep firing.
